provenance.purpose: Separate fixed-budget development study: mean/set representations crossed with an identity residual connection and bag-wide vertex-gauge augmentation.
provenance.design: Forty fresh fits at L4, 2048 training H and 128 reused development validation H, 256 records/H, five fresh paired seeds. Existing scaling and pilot outputs are immutable context, not replacement seed controls.
provenance.data: Read-only prefix of the frozen scaling cache; identical H UIDs, record indices, duplicate-state multiplicities and targets across arms. No resampling or final-test access.
provenance.augmentation: One root-fixed vertex-induced edge mask per whole H bag; independently keyed by paired model seed, epoch and UID. True fields are not inputs. Magnitudes unchanged. Exact equilibrium symmetry does not remove finite-initialization bias.
provenance.training_policy: Adam1e-4, batch16 H, 200-epoch maximum, 30 grace/30 patience at1e-6, strict best original-view validation includingepoch0. Common policy, not equal realized compute.
provenance.diagnostics: Sixteen fixed held-H gauge views after selected-model evaluation; diagnostic only, not checkpoint selection or independent validation H. No test-time group averaging for primary scores.
provenance.metrics: Magnitude MSE primary; reference-sign-assisted D5 secondary. Native signed inverse results are reported separately. Per-H unit of uncertainty; neural seeds are not independent training banks.
provenance.scope: Implementation prepared ahead of scaling review as authorized23October2026. Retain N2048 as the prospectively proposed budget; review scaling and actual worker timing before long training. Honeycomb, other graph types and new network families are deferred.
provenance.long_runs: User launches research training. CUDA required with no CPU fallback. Shared .venv; bounded atomic pause/resume. No research training during implementation.
